subject: Dark Surge bank access in Battleground Jedi
status: Static geometry and recorded private match observations; proposed qualification drill. No controller promotion.
units: Stock JKL world coordinates; z for waypoints is floor height before adding the actor center offset.

approach.geometry: The approach crosses a recessed channel. Sector 6 has a separate depression in sector 61; the suggested landing and braking path stay on the solid west-side terrain.

floor_sampling.method: XY polygon inclusion on authored solid floor faces, every .01 units plus endpoint, lateral offsets -.065, 0, +.065. No flight or collision replay.

ordinary_graph.interpretation: Directed, currently traversable edges from the nearest owner waypoint at ordinary graph completion. For item 35 a waypoint exists; no directed path from these sampled starts was reported. Later water-surface jumps and respawns can change access.

later_motion.interpretation: All recorded approaches within .18 were from a nearby spawn. Old pull caught events and proximity are indirect; count actual own-player TAKEN separately. The stock #21 spawn is also inside the same high bank in sector 61.

known_rejections: Dry running-jump enumeration skips an unreachable forward endpoint before checking its return and running collision sweeps.

RunJump_Runway requires its minimum .30-unit dry runway to stay within .05 units of launch height. The sampled diagonal starts 0.081994 higher. Allowing a disconnected endpoint alone does not admit this diagonal.
A dry standing Force jump is capped at 1.2 horizontal units, shorter than this crossing.
controller_constraints.proposal: First use a single isolated stock-physics crossing drill from the Light bank; test existing ordinary inputs, static support, measured launch speed, collision sweeps, acceptable falls, and a safe reverse path. Consider a guarded slope-aware launch or a different heading only after successful replay.

fixture_check: native/tests/stock_water_replay/replay.c: requires an underwater start and plays WATER_EXIT edges. native/tests/stock_navigation_replay/run.py: supports Bespin and Nar cases only and starts a loopback game. Neither accepts an arbitrary dry BGJ running launch. No game, flight, or return was run for this receipt.
acceptance: From a living, independently reachable sector outside 6 and 61, document ordinary-input takeoff, supported stable landing in 6, owner-specific TAKEN of #35, and same-life safe exit. Check in both private 1x and accelerated practice before adding it to normal movement; keep source placement excluded from scored locomotion.
